shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json next.config.ts package.json && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx && nl -ba app/product/page.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

workspace = Path('/home/sandbox/workspace')
cache = workspace / '.next'
assert cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink()
assert cache.resolve().parent == workspace
shutil.rmtree(cache)

generated_types = workspace / 'next-env.d.ts'
assert generated_types.is_file() and not generated_types.is_symlink()
generated_types.unlink()
PY"
